primary_window.end: observed positive SNOTEL SWE peak date inclusive

diagnostic_bounds.signed_hour_cancellation: gross positive applied CoE melt minus max(sum signed applied CoE melt, 0), aggregated only over the frozen window; no state feedback
diagnostic_bounds.cold_content_opportunity: min(stage3 incoming liquid, positive stage3 cold content before / (rho_water * latent_heat_fusion)), daily; no state feedback
diagnostic_bounds.combined_bound: report overlap explicitly; never sum signed-hour and cold-content bounds as independent recovery

assumed_for_execution_screens.downstream_storage_dominant: median (retained positive change + refrozen) / incoming >= 0.5 at three or more sites
assumed_for_execution_screens.preexport_interaction_material: median opportunity bound / observed-minus-modeled peak SWE deficit >= 0.25 at three or more sites
assumed_for_execution_screens.systemic_direction: same direction at all four sites and at least 75 percent of eligible primary site-years
assumed_for_execution_screens.upstream_generation_tracks_loss: site median gross-positive applied melt / solid-pack loss lies in [0.8, 1.2] at three or more sites

claim_limits: CoE A/B/C/D are empirical melt-depth contributions, not physical energy shares
opportunity bounds are feedback-free and are not simulated SWE recovery
legacy routing is a rollback bound, not correction authority
forcing and observation uncertainty remain unless directly tested
no production correction or calibration is authorized
